digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Surface-parity census must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) and disposition each as in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason
Config-effect contrast tests must prove each config key changes real behavior through the actual read path, not merely that values are parsed

Contention cases must route by shape to existing shared suites: composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones fixture, write-storm/retry to storm suite, read-integrity-under-contention to reads-under-sync-contention harness
Behavioral gate findings must have RED test written first in the same change before the fix; non-behavioral findings exempt
Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep must enumerate all census out-of-scope slots and mark each as filed, accepted-with-reason, or fixed
